text: Siobhan's knee op is booked for May 14. Her husband is taking her in that morning and she's off work for six weeks afterwards. Text her the day after to see how she's doing.
yetunde works at the royal free, theatre nurse, been there 11 yrs. lives in kentish town w her sister

Sean mentioned his boss Fiona is leaving end of the month to go to a rival firm. Nobody knows who's replacing her yet and he's quietly hoping it's him, but he's not sure he wants the extra hours with the baby on the way. He's got a chat with HR on October 29 and he'll know more the week after. Ask him how it went.
Mila had her gallbladder out on Tuesday, home the next day. Bit sore but says the hospital food was the worst part lol
Call Tariq on Friday, his dad's surgery is Thursday and he'll want to talk about it the day after.

Idris - new client lead at Santos & Co, took over from Camila in September. Very particular about invoices, wants everything PDF, hates calls before 10. Based in their Birmingham office but comes down to London most Tuesdays. Married, one little boy, mad about cricket and keeps talking about a trip to watch the Ashes.

Georgia's mum has been in hospital since last weekend with a chest infection. Georgia is driving up and down to Leeds every other day and is completely shattered. I should offer to have the kids Saturday.
um so Natasha said her scan is June 3rd and then she gets the results like a week after, she's trying not to think about it but she's obviously nervous. Need to send her something nice the day before
Olga - lives in Walthamstow, two boys, husband is a sous chef. Originally from Kazan.
chris presenting to the board 5/22. nervous as hell. text him that morning
Appraisal with Michael moved to Thursday. Bring the Q3 numbers.
Caitlin's cat Biscuit had a tooth out today, she was more stressed than the cat. Vet says he's fine.
Marisol (Mari to everyone at work) starts her new role in procurement on July 7th. Her manager is Aneesh Patel. She's excited but a bit worried about the commute from Croydon.

Got off the phone with Bethany. Her grandad fell on Sunday and broke his hip, op was yesterday and apparently went well. He's 89 so they're keeping him in for at least a fortnight. She's going to visit every evening after work, which honestly sounds exhausting with the twins. Her brother Emil is flying in from Stockholm on the 12th to help. Remember to drop round some food for them this week and ask how the grandad's doing.
Fatima's husband Jamal had his hernia repair on Monday. Off work till November 3. She says he's a terrible patient
dentist 2:30 thurs, pick up prescription after
Adriana: works at Deloitte in audit, coeliac, lives in Clapham with her girlfriend Demi. Has a sausage dog called Pickle.
Don't forget Camila's leaving drinks on the 30th. Chip in for the card and present, Zoe is collecting.
Olivia mentioned Tunde's appraisal went badly and he's thinking about leaving. Keep an eye on him, maybe grab lunch next week.
Björn is the new IT guy, Swedish, sits next to finance. Very into climbing and sourdough.

Sana's endoscopy got cancelled again, third time. She'd already done the prep the night before and taken the day off, so she's furious. They've rebooked for August 19 but she's not holding her breath. Her sister Fatima is going with her next time and they're going for brunch afterwards to make up for it.
Seo-yeon - her dad is having a hip replacement on 6/18 in Busan. She's flying out the week before and staying a month. Ask her to send updates and check in once she's back.
Valentina said her daughter Caitlin got into the nursing programme at King's! Starts in September.
remember to ask Simone how her mum's biopsy went, it was this morning
spoke w Jamal re the Osei account. client wants revised quote by Fri. Jamal's off next wk for his wife's due date so I'm covering
Meeting with Mrs Tanaka moved from March 4 to March 11, she's in hospital for a small procedure the day before the original date. Send her a get well card.
Natasha's fine now, all clear from the specialist. Huge relief for her and Sean.
Demi keeps saying she wants one of those massive Le Creuset pots. Her birthday's April 2nd. Noted.
Note to self: GP rang, blood test results normal. Physio starts next Wednesday, 9am.
Idris and his wife are going to Lisbon for their tenth anniversary, flying out Oct 28. He's been planning it for months.
Michael Wright from the client side has a new baby girl, born at the weekend. Everyone on the call was asking. Should send something from the team.
Fiona's brother-in-law runs the garage on Mill Lane. Her son is at Bristol doing engineering.

So yeah Aneesh had his appendix out last week, emergency, completely out of nowhere. He was at his desk on the Monday, in A&E that night, surgery the next morning. Home now but signed off for two weeks and he can't lift anything, which is a pain because they've just got a puppy. His partner is working from home to help. Must text him Thursday and also sort cover for his client meetings.
Georgia's wedding was meant to be June 21 but it's off. She and Emil split up a month ago. She's okay-ish, staying with her sister in Bath for now.
Olga's oldest has his tonsils out on the 9th. She's taking the week off. Message her the night before
tunde and olivia both off fri for her sister's wedding in lagos, back weds
Zoe's dog Bruno went missing Saturday, found him Sunday morning two streets over. She's still shaken.
Sean's new manager is Valentina Petrov. He says she's sharp but a micromanager. Ex-McKinsey.
Need to book my own MOT before the 15th and cancel the gym membership. Nothing else this week thank god.
Seo-yeon is pregnant! Due December 2nd. Morning sickness has been brutal so she's working from home Mondays and Fridays.

Caitlin is moving to Manchester in the spring, her partner got a job at the Christie as a radiographer. She's sad to leave the team and a bit anxious about finding a flat up there, they've got viewings on March 8 and March 9. Her last day is probably end of Feb. Get her a leaving present, she mentioned wanting a decent pair of walking boots for the Peak District.
Mila's mum - lives in Gdansk, retired teacher, comes over every summer. Mila's dad passed in 2019.
Chris was really struggling on the call today. His mum's dementia is getting worse and they're looking at care homes. I should ring him at the weekend, not just text.
Bethany's interview at the hospice is May 8 at 11. She asked if I'd read over her answers the day before. Wish her luck that morning too.
Emil's physio said another six weeks before he can run. He's gutted, had the Berlin half in April. Fundraiser instead?
Jamal - Big J - is our main contact at Yilmaz Logistics. Lives in Leicester, supports Forest, two kids at uni.
Marisol's daughter is having grommets put in on the 4/27. Small thing but she's worried. Ask her how it went afterwards.
Thinking I'll take the 14th off for my own appointment and then work from home the day after. Haven't told anyone at work yet.
Simone works nights at the Whittington, lives in Archway with her partner Tunde and their son. Her mum lives with them since the stroke.
Sana mentioned her boss Mr Ibrahim is retiring at Christmas after 30 years. Leaving do is Dec 18. Card going round next week.

Valentina's back on Monday after her hysterectomy. Take it easy on her, she's still tired and on reduced hours for the first fortnight, her consultant wants her back in for a check on November 12. She told me her husband Chris has been brilliant but the kids are driving her up the wall. Maybe flowers on her desk that morning.

so Tariq's wife is having their second in about three weeks and he's going on paternity leave the week before, and then he wants us to cover the Patel pitch on the 3rd, which is the day after he goes, so yeah, need to prep that with Georgia this week
Fatima said her nephew Idris just passed his driving test, first go. She was thrilled.
Adriana's dad had a heart attack last Thursday. Stable now, coming home on November 1. She's flying to Porto tomorrow and back the week after. Text her over the weekend.

Olivia loves Ottolenghi, collects vintage Pyrex, allergic to cats. Lives near Victoria Park in a flat above a bakery, which she says is both heaven and a disaster. Works in comms at the council, used to be a journalist. Her brother Jamal is a paramedic and her mum lives in Accra.
Groceries, bin day moved to Tuesday, return parcel.
Björn and his wife Mila are having their housewarming on Nov 8. They've just bought in Hackney after renting for years.
Demi's grandma is having cataract surgery on the 2nd and Demi is taking her in that morning and staying overnight. Don't forget to ask Demi how it went the next day.
Camila Santos - client at the agency, quiet but very sharp. Her husband is a GP in Richmond and she has a teenage daughter who rows.

Caught up with Zoe and Michael over lunch. Michael's back from Japan, the client trip went fine apparently. Zoe has her probation review on June 10 and she's convinced it'll go badly even though her manager loves her. Michael mentioned his wife Yetunde is going back to work after maternity leave in July, part time at first. Text Zoe the evening after her review.
